globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: a tailored navy-blue blazer over a crisp light-blue open-collar formal shirt, no tie (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: a seamless, plain, very light ivory off-white studio backdrop (almost white, with only a faint warm tint), brightly and evenly lit from edge to edge with no falloff, no vignette, no shadows, no texture and no objects - nothing else in the frame; identical in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: Lively but controlled gestures at chest height with relaxed fingers close together; when he refers to the slide he turns his head AND shoulders toward the LEFT and opens his RIGHT hand, palm up, toward the empty area on the LEFT of the frame, forearm extended and elbow bent, the whole hand staying inside that empty area, at least a hand's width away from the left edge of the frame; then he faces the camera again. He stays standing in the same spot, at the same distance from the camera, throughout
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, clear and energetic, continuous speech at a brisk trainer's pace, NO background music, NO sound effects, NO silence at the start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: He stays in the same spot with his face and upper body fully visible at all times; NO arms, elbows or shoulders cut off by the frame edges, NO oversized hands, NO hands held toward the camera, NO thin or lanky body, NO wide-angle lens distortion, NO arm stretched out to the frame edge, NO arms, elbows, hands or shoulders touching or cut by the frame edges, NO big or spread-out fingers, NO furniture, NO bookshelves, NO plants, NO lamps, NO props, NO objects behind him, NO icons or graphics, NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO tripod, NO camera or microphone or any studio equipment visible in frame, NO other people
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, vertical. A natural MEDIUM-WIDE shot framed from just above his knees up, at a normal distance with a natural portrait-lens look (no wide-angle distortion). He stands slightly RIGHT of centre with a clear gap between his body and the RIGHT edge of the frame and a WIDE empty area of plain backdrop on the LEFT - about a third of the frame width - so that when he gestures toward the left his hand stays well inside the frame. Clear space above his head. Eye level, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session against a plain ivory backdrop, NOT a furnished room. Soft, bright, even high-key light: a soft frontal key light on his face with soft fill, no harsh shadows, natural skin texture, natural eye contact and accurate lip sync, identical exposure and white balance in every scene. TRUE-TO-LIFE BODY: natural adult proportions that match his face - broad shoulders, a solid average build that fills the jacket (not slim, not lanky), and SLENDER, NATURAL-SIZE HANDS: each hand no longer than his face, relaxed fingers held close together, never spread wide, hands never closer to the camera than his chest
globalStyle.delivery: Highly energetic, enthusiastic legal trainer leading a masterclass, like a motivating coach talking straight to camera to law students: bright smile, lively eyes, confident emphasis on key words, brisk clear pace, a tiny pause after each full stop; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word, never add words

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing slightly RIGHT of centre against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, with a small gap to the right edge and a wide empty area of backdrop on the LEFT third of the frame, medium-wide shot from just above the knees up, natural proportions, speaking energetically to camera with slender natural hands at chest height, no text.
scenes.dialogue: Every civil case in India begins with one question. Not 'Who is right?' Not 'How much can I claim?'

scenes.visual3D: The presenter standing slightly RIGHT of centre against the plain, evenly lit ivory backdrop, small gap to the right edge and a wide empty area of backdrop on the LEFT third of the frame, same position, size and framing as every other clip. Early in the line, while he says 'do you have a cause of action', he turns his head AND shoulders toward the LEFT and opens his RIGHT hand, palm up, toward the empty LEFT area like a teacher presenting the slide beside him - forearm extended, elbow bent, the whole hand inside that empty area, a hand's width away from the left edge - then faces the camera again with both hands at chest height. Feet stay in place, no text.
scenes.dialogue: The first question is: do you have a cause of action? Get this wrong, and your suit can be thrown out before the defendant even files a written statement.
